observations.friction: During installed-root acceptance checks, rule://plan, rule://plan-repo-storage, and rule://plan-impl-spec resolved but exposed bytes older than their current repository source counterparts, leaving runtime policy consumers at risk of applying stale plan rules.

observations.friction: Exact projection of two finalized specification checks made plan publication fail with DIRECT_CHECK_INVALID because they used a period and capitalized Expect instead of the required semicolon-expect delimiter.
observations.workaround: The existing specification author mechanically corrected only the two delimiters in a new bound revision; ticketing refreshed the exact projection and republished successfully.

pc-6d31171d9c5f04c1.summary: Final specification Check strings can omit the lean-plan parser's required semicolon-expect delimiter.

observations.friction: A final confirmation interaction exposed confirmation choices without the proposal body they were meant to bind, forcing a repeated proposal and risking approval of unseen content.

observations.friction: Two proof or control runs left an authoritative native observation vulnerable when an enclosing finite Eval expired while a child wait was still pending; the latest recurrence terminally blocked the required lifecycle proof even though the child later settled.
observations.workaround: Use direct hub collection or persist the complete original outside ephemeral Eval state before any further wait; never reconstruct an original after reset.

pc-8ba3fb81c3a65110.summary: Bounded Eval waits can reset ephemeral invocation state before the original native observation is retained.

observations.friction: At the same report-production seam, one earlier implementation return lacked canonical Handoff grammar and the later T1 PID-correction return wrapped exact Behavior/Check projections in outer Markdown code ticks while escaping embedded ticks. Both otherwise-complete returns were blocked from admission.
observations.workaround: Produce the report from the canonical Handoff template, splice exact Behavior/Check lines directly from the current plan bytes, and verify byte equality while preserving retained Observed lines. Carry durable prevention guidance to the existing assembled-target learning stage.

pc-8f42da4f483dde9a.summary: Exact Handoff reports are manually composed instead of mechanically projecting the canonical envelope and source acceptance lines.

observations.friction: Two independent fresh sizing route completions selected the correct owner, topology, and assurance but omitted Approval because proposal-only route presentation was not explicitly distinguished from dispatch.
